environment.experiment: Coarse stage wrappers delegating to actual implementations; separate process from uninstrumented experiment
environment.dom: Vitest happy-dom, not browser paint/GPU/network latency
environment.setup: Real public default Browser Host, published default manifest and CSS exports, one compiled business extension. Host creation/activation and fixture compilation occur outside named lifecycle batches. CSS asset I/O is process-cached by public export path.

units: Milliseconds per complete named batch; *Calls/*Batches/*Hits are operation counts; cache sizes are entries; resource sizes are UTF-8 bytes; nearest-rank p95

boundaries.deriveMs: Actual deriveThemeSourceV4 call boundary; source validation remains in declaration-batch preparation
boundaries.seedDeclarationBatchMs: Actual successful cache-miss seedResolver.resolve batch minus nested derive/Kernel durations. Includes validation, serialization, Element Plus declaration mapping, freezing and LRU insertion. No per-token hooks.
boundaries.seedCacheHitMs: Successful warm seedResolver.resolve path, counted separately from declaration serialization
boundaries.domOwnerMs: Whole compositionOwner prepare/validate/apply/commit/finalize/attach/detach/dispose batches, including actual style leases/attributes and ownership bookkeeping. No per-variable hooks; lexical internal calls are not double-wrapped.
boundaries.totalMs: Instrumented complete operation batch, not a substitute for the independent uninstrumented report; stages do not claim to cover all Host/Runtime overhead
